verdict.rationale: Postman offers automation building blocks — CLI collection runs in CI/CD pipelines, webhooks, and a programmatic API (postman-docs-1, postman-docs-6, postman-docs-19, postman-docs-24, postman-docs-32) — and an MCP Generator/Agent Mode for AI interaction (postman-docs-8, postman-docs-9), but these are schedule/CI-triggered or interactive assistant features rather than evidence of self-directed, unattended AI agent automations running continuously in the background. Missing for 10: documented scheduled/monitor-style autonomous jobs, evidence of AI agents independently triggering and managing Postman workflows without human or CI trigger, and any hands-on validation of such autonomous runs.
